question: Sun temple at Modhera was built by which of the following rulers?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Raja Bhimdev I**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** Sun Temple at Modhera** was built by King Bhimdev I of the S**olanki dynasty in 1026 AD**.
 
• The temple is **located in the village of Modhera, **in the Mehsana district of Gujarat, India. 
 
• The** Solanki dynasty were descendants** of the Sun and built the temple to honor Suryadeva, the Hindu sun god. 
 
• The temple is considered a **remarkable example of Gujarat's** rich architectural and cultural heritage. 
 
• The temple is located on the** banks of the Pushpavati river**, about 100 kilometers north of Ahmedabad. 
 
• The temple is considered an endangered monument by the Archaeological Survey of India (ASI).
